usage_note: Only the head noun 'izlase' (feminine, 5th declension) declines. 'Latvijas hokeja' is a fixed genitive modifier and does not change. The synonym 'Latvijas hokeja valstsvienība' declines the same way: valstsvienība, -as, -ai, -u, -ā. In running copy the team is usually just 'Latvija', which declines as a country (e.g. 'Latvija uzvarēja Kanādu', 'spēlē pret Latviju'). It is also often called 'Latvijas izlase' or simply 'izlase'. No quotation marks are used, since this is a national team, not a club. The vocative is identical to the nominative and is used in chants and headlines ('Latvija, uz priekšu!').
